import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *
failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:400]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:400])
    else: print('ok  ',name)
def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}

# headers_kv preserves JSON member order and uses pair coordinates
t0 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/v',0)
t1 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/1/v',0)
t2 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/2/n',0)
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{":method":"GET","x-1":"<<random_string>>","<<random_string>>":"z"},"End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
pairs = [(':method',b'GET'),('x-1',t0.encode()),(t2,b'z')]
check('headers_kv order+coords', c['sent'], fp(action(0,0,'H',pairs,True)))
check('headers_kv payload', c['payload_bytes'], sum(len(n)+len(v) for n,v in pairs))
check('headers_kv frames', (c['frames'],c['request_frames']), (1,1))

# list form keeps duplicates
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["dup","1"],["dup","2"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('duplicate pairs', c['sent'], fp(action(0,0,'H',[(b'dup',b'1'),(b'dup',b'2')],True)))

# datagram ignores End_Stream but counts in payload_bytes and frames
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":path","/"]]},
                                       {"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"GG","End_Stream":True},
                                       {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"DD","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
exp = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':path',b'/')],False)+action(0,0,'G',b'GG',False)+action(0,0,'D',b'DD',True)
check('mixed frames', (c['frames'],c['request_frames'],c['payload_bytes'],c['sent']),
      (3,2,2+2+4+3+2,fp(exp)))

# event data after a response end is ignored, but headers before it are kept
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"q","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"one","end":False},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":3,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"two","end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('response end stops retention', (c['response_frames'],c['response_body'],c['received']),
      (2,fp(b'one'),fp(action(1,0,'d',b'one',False)+action(2,0,'h',[(b':status',b'200')],True))))
check('ok time', (c['state'],c['at']), ('ok',2))

# response events for an unknown stream never affect other cases
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"q","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT},
                  {"name":"b","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"r","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":4,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
cs = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']
check('stream 4 is case b', (cs[0]['state'],cs[1]['state'],cs[1]['response_frames'],cs[1]['at']),
      ('timeout','ok',1,1))

# big virtual times
doc = base(timeout_ms=1000000000,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":9223372036854775000}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":9223372036854775000,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('huge pause closed', (c['state'],c['at']), ('closed',9223372036854775000))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
